title: 2^n 规模墙：为什么需要 DPLL/CDCL
expected_output:
n      assignments 2^n        at 1e9/s         clauses (4.26n, 3-SAT)
--------------------------------------------------------------
10     1.024e+03              1.024e-06        43
20     1.049e+06              1.049e-03        85
30     1.074e+09              1.074e+00        128
40     1.100e+12              1.100e+03        170
50     1.126e+15              1.126e+06        213
60     1.153e+18              1.153e+09        256

n=20   2^20  ~ 1e6      -> brute force is fine
n=40   2^40  ~ 1e12     -> 11 days at 1e9/s
n=60   2^60  ~ 1e18     -> 31 years at 1e9/s

key: 2-SAT has an O(n+m) algorithm because (a v b) becomes two implications,
     and an implication graph with no (x, ~x) in one SCC is satisfiable.
     3-SAT has no such structure -- that is exactly why it is NP-complete.
